Synopsis:
A Reuters Breakingviews weekend roundup covering four main threads: (1) Oil above $100 and 10-year UST yields nearing 5% as macro backdrop; (2) A review of a new book on Apollo Global Management, examining its Drexel origins, Athene insurance model, and unresolved debate over private credit risk; (3) Apple's foldable iPhone and Nvidia's AI chip dominance and customer financing strategy; (4) A 25th anniversary reflection on 9/11's long-term fiscal and defense industry consequences.
